t: Marcus. Your work experience form. Under where would you like to work, you wrote: anywhere with pudding.
It's a strong application.
You are going to Switchback. It is a mountain. It has a cable car. It is educational.
Does it have pudding?
There is a vending machine at the summit. Nobody has reached the summit in eleven years.
(slowly) ...So the pudding is still in there.
Coo.
The pigeon is not going.
(out of breath) Hello? Trainee Marcus. Reporting for... whatever this is.
Ines. Station master. You are standing at level zero. Everything on this mountain is counted from here.
Up is plus. The mine is minus.
There's a minus? You dug a hole in the numbers?
Five levels of it. Logged.
You logged that?
I log everything.
Last night's storm wiped the station board. Every number on this line is gone.
(pointing at the sign) Days since last incident: zero? That wasn't me! I just got here!
It was the storm. The sign doesn't care.
Why is that goat wearing a staff badge?
That is Keith. Assistant station manager. He will need to see your paperwork.
He ate it.
Then it's approved.
And you brought a pigeon.
Coo.
(listening) He says he is a safety inspector. He says this line fails four checks. And he would like a desk.
He said all that?
Coo.
(looking at Doug, already behind the desk) It is, undeniably, a Doug. Logged.
Nothing runs until the inspector signs off. Four checks. One: how far a car moved, and which way.
Two: how steep the line is, when the posts are not evenly spaced.
Three: whether the ticket machine is doing its one job.
Four: an equation the storm left half solved on the winch.
Four checks. Easy. I've done slope. I landed in a duck pond, but I did it.
There is no duck pond up here.
Finally.
There is a goat pen.
(quietly) He's looking at me like he knows.
The inspector wants every trainee checked. Not only you.
There are other trainees?
(to the audience) A whole class of them. They have been watching this entire time.
(turning to the audience) ...Oh. Hi.
Coo.
He says: four questions. On your own. No talking.
Where does the pigeon sleep?
He has taken your bunk. Logged.
